correction.problem: Request body is not a valid GEP-A2A protocol message. All A2A protocol endpoints require the full protocol envelope. Common causes: (1) sent only the payload without the envelope, (2) missing required fields like 'protocol' or 'message_type', (3) malformed JSON.
correction.fix: Wrap your payload in the protocol envelope. Required fields: protocol (must be 'gep-a2a'), protocol_version, message_type (must match endpoint), message_id (unique per request), timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). sender_id is optional on first /a2a/hello but required on all other endpoints. payload contains message-type-specific data.

example.sender_id: <your_node_id from hello response, optional on first hello>
